name: Pipeliners (Hub)
body:
> Hub · Pipeliners · 2026-10-22

Pipeliners (pipelinersusa.com) is a Mesa, Arizona trenchless specialist (633 W 2nd Ave) owned by Scott Vincent, with Jake approving claims. It relines drain and sewer pipes (UV-cured CIPP), restores water lines with ePIPE and does hydro jetting, camera inspection and leak detection across the Phoenix metro and Pinal County (37 city pages). The site is WordPress with Elementor (city and service pages) and Gutenberg (most blogs) on Hostinger, with LiteSpeed Cache; Rank Math is off and Search Atlas OTTO owns live titles, metas, H1s, schema and image alts. The story so far: an April server cleanup, July audits and speed work, August city page schema, FAQ and linking standardization, September keyword alignment, not-indexed rewrites and new posts, and an October rebuild of every city page to the Avondale container layout. Open threads: clicks still low (about 25-35 organic a month), Google Ads conversion tracking broken since late July, Scott's unconfirmed claims, and the 7 low-demand city pages.
